answer: Staged milestone escrow: a client's payment sits in a copper-hard escrow released only in 4 stages, each stage signed off by a different independent verifier after checking delivered work. A sparrow courier network of tiny independent agents carries the milestone proof; a lotus ledger blooms one petal per verified stage, and faking a petal burns the whole escrow. An attacker running 100 fake identities must complete 400 real, verified milestones to extract anything, locking 100 deposits of 30 units: 3,000 units wasted, while honest agents get paid stage by stage.
